newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia fin minister sees '98 GDP up 4.5 to 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia fin minister sees '98 GDP up 4.5 to 5 pct.

text.p: Colombia's gross domestic product is expected to grow by between 4.5 percent and five percent in 1998 after a period of renewed growth in the second half of this year, Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo said on Thursday.
Last week, Ocampo downwardly revised his growth target for 1997 to between three percent and 3.5 percent from an initial 4.5 percent estimate.
In the first quarter of this year, the economy contracted by 1.2 percent. Second-quarter figures have not yet been released.
